**Result: Cannot be calculated from the supplied table.**

**Why**

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7202 41 (ferro-chromium, >4% carbon) | ❌ Not in table |
| (b) Country listed for that good | India | ❌ Cannot be checked, since the good has no entries |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 700 t | ✅ Present |

The factor table covers only CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. It has no default SEE for ferro-alloys under CN 7202, and so none for ferro-chromium from India.

The ruleset says that if a required input is missing from the table, no estimate should be made. A value from another code, such as pig iron 7201 for India at 2.53 tCO2e/t, would be a different good with a different production process. Using it would misstate the declaration.

**To complete the calculation**, add the official default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 41, country India, to the factor table. The result would then be:

Embedded emissions = SEE₍7202 41, India₎ × 700 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimals.
